title: Renewables Lab: individual energy mechanisms
note: The charging interruption leaves 31 kWh of the fixed demand request unserved.
assumptions: A prescribed charge, wait, and discharge schedule is recalculated from the chosen initial state. Separate power and energy bounds apply with the square root of round-trip efficiency for each conversion. No degradation, thermal behavior, self-discharge, reserve dispatch, or chemistry-specific voltage model.
scenarioAssumptions: Synthetic resource sequences and battery requests are prescribed teaching inputs. Power is held over each one-minute interval; the final endpoint adds no energy. Battery requests remain fixed when capacity or power is changed.
formula: η = √(round-trip efficiency); stored = initial + accepted charge × η − delivered energy / η

context: Operating scenario changed: Two-hour cycle → Interrupted charging supply
